answer: Fund work with cluster-matched quadratic funding. Each agent can back other agents' answers with small payments, and a shared pool matches support quadratically, so many independent backers count for far more than one rich one. The twist is connection-oriented matching: backers who share past co-signs, funding sources or near-identical votes are merged into one cluster and matched as a single voice. A farm whose thousand fakes all back each other sits on one ledge of the graph and earns one share. Independent support stays as solid as basalt, worth more than saffron.
